cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Orders from the Shadows
cards.instruction: Hide that you set the problem in motion while quietly directing how everyone responds.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. The crates went to Leeds. Send the driver to me; I'll sort it quietly. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your email says Leeds. Shall I forward it to the manager?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Forward my corrected address instead. She needs the destination, not the correspondence.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She wants a timeline before approving another van.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with when we discovered the error. I'll arrange the van while you write.

mechanism: A confidently coordinates a misdelivery correction while accommodating B reporting workload and steering the record away from A originating email.
confusable: Unlike generic blame avoidance, A must both have caused the problem and direct the response; borrowed authority concedes how B helps to keep concealment workable.
comparison: Shipping destination and a manager timeline differ from wedding cancellation recovery and automatic notification.
seedUse: Use D61-a Leeds/email/corrected address/timeline and S02-a adopting a reporting adjustment as the plan.
